Bill.BriefDescription: Encouraging businesses to locate in vacant buildings through a business and occupation tax credit for property taxes paid.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to encouraging businesses to locate in vacantbuildings through a business and occupation tax credit for propertytaxes paid; adding a new section to chapter 82.04 RCW; providing anexpiration date; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In computing the tax imposed under this chapter, a credit isallowed for property taxes and leasehold excise taxes paid during thecalendar year. (2) The credit is equal to: (a) Property taxes paid on buildings, and land upon which thebuildings are located, that are existing structures and vacant fortwelve months or longer. (b) Leasehold excise taxes paid with respect to buildings, the landupon which the buildings are located, or both, that are existingstructures and vacant for twelve months or longer. (3) A credit earned during one calendar year may be carried over to p. 1 HB 1457be credited against taxes incurred in a subsequent calendar year, butmay not be carried over a second year. No refunds may be granted forcredits under this section. (4) This section expires June 30, 2013.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
